data_type: Wholly synthetic educational illustration; no observed lending data
assumptions: The full principal is drawn before the first period and stays outstanding until the end of the last period.
Each period is exactly one twelfth of a year; no actual calendar dates or day-count convention are modelled.
Interest is paid separately in cash each period; it is simple interest and does not compound or increase debt.
The single fee is assumed paid separately in cash once, in period1; it never increases interest-bearing principal.
Principal is repaid once at the final period end; principal repayment is excluded from finance-cost totals.
There are no extension or exit fees, minimum-interest provisions, rate changes, interim repayments or other charges.
The model does not establish that an extension is available or permitted by any loan agreement.
comparison_rule: Compare A and B at the same duration when comparing pricing. Compare B20 with A18 only to measure delay exposure against an earlier assumed budget, not to rank equivalent offers.
